name: Elderly
overview: Scripture emphasizes honoring and respecting the elderly as a command from God, promising long life for those who honor their parents (Exodus 20:12) and instructing to rise before the aged and honor them as a reverence to the Lord (Leviticus 19:32). The wisdom and understanding that come with length of days are highly valued (Job 12:12), and the Psalms express a heartfelt plea for God's continued care and strength in old age (Psalms 71:9, 71:18). The righteous are depicted as flourishing and growing strong even in advanced years, symbolized by the enduring palm tree and cedar (Psalms 92:12), underscoring the dignity and ongoing purpose of the elderly within God's design.
